scope: One small deployment with one Writ and an optional practice target, before a final live quote. Excludes a new Sputnik DAO, additional Writs, market purchase prices and funding multiple demonstration accounts. Not a spending approval or final bill.
storageTreatment: Protocol storage stakes are locked while data remains. Application record allocations are retained and are not automatically refundable. Executor operating reserve is not withdrawable through the current implementation.
